title: Psychomotor sexological therapy
blurb: We work with both conversation and body. Psychomotor therapy unites cognition and sensation — a natural path to sexual wellbeing.
body:
## The meeting

You're allowed to be in the room before you have to explain yourself. We begin by arriving and noticing what's there — without it having to lead anywhere in particular. There's no test to pass.

### When words aren't _enough_

Sometimes we stay with conversation. Other times we work with movement, breath, and touch, always within what you open to yourself. That's often where something long held finally lets go.

### In your own _order_

A course of sessions might be about desire, boundaries, relationships, or the body — rarely in a fixed sequence. You don't need to know exactly what you're bringing; we find the direction as we go.
